  "quote": "# Small revision note: COUNT and missing values\n\nA table contains score values 1: 10, 20, and NULL. COUNT(*) counts every row, including a row whose score is NULL, so its result is 3. COUNT(score) counts only non-NULL scores, so its result is 2. AVG(score) ignores NULL values and computes (10 + 20) / 2 = 15. NULL means missing or unknown information; it is not the number zero."
